places.name: Fort Smith
places.note: Before dawn July and Joe arm themselves at the jail, Roscoe gives Joe an old hat, and the two ride out leaving Roscoe in charge.

places.name: Arkansas River
places.note: Shining at the end of the street as July leaves; old Darton lives across it and keeps falling off the ferry.
places.location_hint: runs past Fort Smith, with a ferry to the north bank

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Roscoe grumbles that July must mean to reach it in a day, leaving so early.

groups.label: July and Joe
groups.hint: just riding out of town away from the river, bound south toward Texas after Jake Spoon
